My mom and I dont have a good relationship at all, ever since I've moved in with my boyfriend it's gotten better. But not really. Now, she won't stop calling me and texting me demanding to tell her where it is and that "I got it for you, I can touch it whenever I want." she thinks I'm disrespectful for not letting her touch my very delicate and expensive instrument. AITA?
